question: Can spiders spin webs in space?
short_answer: Yes, spiders (such as orb-weavers Anita and Arabella on Skylab 3 in 1973) can spin functional webs in microgravity. While initial webs were uneven, the spiders quickly adapted to spin symmetric 3D webs.
full_explanation: Later ISS experiments with Golden Silk Orb-weavers demonstrated that spiders utilize light direction to structure their web orientation when gravitational cues are absent.
